Sets the tissue T1, T2 and T2* — Manual allows editing them
Preset values from Peters et al., Magn Reson Imaging 2007 (CSF T2* assumed equal to T2), rounded. Manual allows editing all values.
Uses lots of simplifying assumptions (especially instantaneous readout!) but should convey main concepts of contrast generation. This is a modified version of the MRI contrast simulator by Daniel Gallichan (GitHub) — original MATLAB implementation built with help from AI.
